northern-ireland.verifyNote: TRAP, read this before touching these figures. The same PDF prints a second table headed REDUCED RATES on page 2: 108, 120, 135 and 158 pounds a week. Those are NOT the fostering allowance. They are the scale rate less the pocket money and clothing components, used only for calculating Enhanced Allowances and Short Break Payments. Taking them by mistake would understate every Northern Irish figure by about 28 per cent. The rates below are the SCALE rates from page 1.

scotland.note: The Scottish Recommended Allowance was NOT uprated for 2024/25. The rates announced on 29 August 2023 remained in force for the whole financial year, which is why upliftPercent is 0 rather than absent. Scotland publishes four bands (0-4, 5-10, 11-15, 16+) but pays 5-10 and 11-15 the same, which is the three-band design the SRA is built on and the shape this table uses. gov.scot's own August 2023 release gives 11-15 as 19581, identical to 5-10. Several local authority reproductions of the same table instead show 20251 for 11-15. The primary source wins, so 19581 is what ships. The other bands agree across both. Do not switch to 20251 without a gov.scot page or an archived capture saying so.
